title: The Void Collective
description: A vanilla+ server needing dedicated players to help build a working internet! Respect the Cows.
body:
## [Summary]
A Vanilla+ Java survival server **(Age 18+)**. I mostly play solo right now and would love
more neighbors. The world is **6 years old** and could use real investment —
spawn infrastructure and the Nether especially.

## [Info]
- **IP**: voidcraft.cute.dev
- **Version**: 26.2
- **Age**: ~6 years
- **Rules**: Get along with others, respect consent between players. There are no server-wide rules besides **no hate speech**, and **respect consent.** Griefing, killing, and stealing ARE ONLY ALLOWED **with consent from the other party**
- **Events**: Planning on creating events where mods are added briefly to create different atmospheres and scenarios. Event idea recommendations are welcome!
- **Mods**: Server-side mods by request. Except for special events, all mods, to be considered, must be compatible with a vanilla client.

## [Server Identity / Who Am I Looking For]
🏳️‍🌈 🏳️‍⚧️ **Welcome LGBTQIA+*! This is a safe place for people of all genders and sexualities!**

🇵🇸 Freedom to Palestine From Colonial Tyranny! 🏴 - ⛓️🇺🇸⛓️🇮🇱⛓️ - 🏴 
May we all be free someday 💜💜💜

Whatever you're into, there's room to carve out a place:

- 🔨 Builders
- 🟥 Redstoners
- 👩‍💻 CompSci Nerds
- 🪨 Grinders 
- ⛏️ Miners
- 🏆 Achievement junkies
- 🏞️ Explorers
- ✒️ Historians
- 📚 Librarians
- 🎭 Roleplayers

## [Featured Project: Sculknet]
![Sculknet Infrastructure to transmit signals](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a7134e358526ccb3314544f04a159f1b1740278f_0.webp)

The long-term build I'm most excited about is **sculknet** — a fully vanilla, sculk-based "internet" for sending and receiving messages between any base on the server that's wired into a switch. Real in-game network infrastructure. Come help build it, use it, and break it. Help us build communication protocols and control minecraft farms at long distance!

**Current state**: nearly-working prototype in my personal creative world, which I can also upload and invite players to help design the machines!

## [Before You Join]

This is an **18+** community, and I'm looking for **regular players** rather than one-and-done visitors. Queer and trans players especially welcome.

**Click through to our [Discord]([https://discord.gg/JjeAJG74Q](https://discord.gg/DGWYs5MRT))**, and message user `void_femme` to find out more!

## [Server-Side Mod List]
(Many of these mods have client-side counterparts that unlock more functionality!)

### Core & Featured Mods
- 🛠️ **WorldEdit** (v7.4.4-beta-01) — *World editing and building tools*
- 🔄 **Syncmatica** (v0.3.18) — *Share schematics across the server*
- ⚙️ **Tweakeroo** (v0.29.2) — *Server-side client tweaks and helpers*
- 🍎 **AppleSkin** (v3.0.10) — *Food and hunger tooltips*
- 🤖 **Better Copper Golem** (v2.0.0) — *Allows copper golem to sort items vanilla doesn't*
- 👩 **Female Gender Mod** (v5.0.0-Beta.4) — *Gender and physics options*
- 🔨 **Fixed Anvil Repair Cost** (v3.5) — *Removes the 'Too Expensive' cap*
- 📦 **Inventory Management** (v2.0.1) — *Inventory sorting utilities*
- 👁️ **Jade** (v26.2.8) — *What Am I Looking At? information overlay*
- 🛡️ **Your Items Are Safe** (v4.7) — *Graves/item protection upon death*
- 🐚 **Shulker Drops Two** (v3.6) — *Guaranteed double shulker shell drops*
